identity.title: Publish device.gpu.shell in the capability registry

context_capsule.purpose_for_a_reader_without_history: The generated capability registry at assets/capability_registry.json contains the exact entry device.gpu.shell, published through the existing governed workflow with a genuine diff review, so the shell issuer can later bind to a registered full identifier.

specification_anchor_refs.verbatim: The CapabilityRegistry MUST register device.gpu.shell as an exact full identifier with kind=runtime, section_ref=11.1, required_capabilities=[], default_governance_mode=gov_standard, and risk_class=high.

Registry changes MUST preserve existing entries and follow the existing section 11.1.6 genuine extraction from complete authorized inputs, schema validation, integrity checks, actual-diff human review and publication law.
The trusted local kernel MAY initialize and render the Vulkan login screen and application shell before account activation only under the exact registered full capability device.gpu.shell.

closure_unit.outcome: The generated capability registry at assets/capability_registry.json contains the exact entry device.gpu.shell, published through the existing governed workflow with a genuine diff review, so the shell issuer can later bind to a registered full identifier.

materialized_acceptance.text: Genuine extraction from complete authorized inputs at Master Spec v02.229 produces the registry draft; the draft bytes' SHA256 is the registry version.

The published registry contains device.gpu.shell exactly once with kind=runtime, section_ref=11.1, required_capabilities=[], default_governance_mode=gov_standard and risk_class=high (NATIVE-RENDER-REG-001), and every entry that was published before is preserved.
The actual diff against the previous published registry is reviewed by a named human reviewer; the review record binds the exact draft hash. The manual one-entry proposal is not used.
Schema validation, integrity checks and the mechanical_engines.json unchanged-input rule pass, and the publication Flight Recorder event is authentic (not manufactured).
Independent re-read of the published file by a validator: identifier present, hash equal to the recorded version, previous version retained and restorable.

No ordinary profile, role, model, account or string can hold the capability: CapabilityRegistry::can_perform still returns false for device.gpu.shell (capabilities.rs:395 and the test test_shell_gpu_capability_is_not_grantable_by_strings_or_profiles).
The publication claims nothing else: no issuer, no grant, no runtime renderer start, no Vulkan call.
